text:
ben: deploybot attempted canary promote for release v2.14 -> staging, failed at pipeline step `extract-artifacts` with cache restore timeout. Blocked release cut window. Deploybot logs attached. Thoughts? /cc @sara @mike

nina: saw 504 from s3 mirror, also `tar: unexpected EOF` in extract.

sara: can you paste snippet of error? is this the keras-model wheel we pinned yesterday?

ben: log:
```
[extract] ERROR: cache-restore: server error 504
[extract] WARN: incomplete archive for package redwood-keras-model-0.3.1.whl
[extract] ERROR: tar: unexpected EOF
```
We did pin to 0.3.1 in build matrix.

mike: if the wheel is corrupt we can either pin to previous working artifact (0.3.0) or force a rebuild/publish. Rebuild might take ~45m and could miss change window.

nina: is 0.3.0 compatible? there were minor api tweaks but tests passed on canary last week.

sara: tests depend on new output shape from 0.3.1 for some evals. Rolling back might cause regression. Check E2E signal thresholds.

ben: canary smoke failed for inference-service with 0.3.1 extract fail — no runtime test ran. We need decision: pin->promote asap or rebuild artifact and re-run canary.

mike: propose manual pin to 0.3.0 for the release window (hotfix), then schedule a rebuild and run extended canary overnight. OK from infra side.

sara: +1 but flag in release notes and create rollback plan if any downstream breaks.

ben: doing manual promote: pinned model wheel -> `model-wheel:0.3.0` and bumped release tag. Deploybot: @deploy-bot promote --canary --override-artifacts model-wheel=0.3.0

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rocking the canary promote. Started promote job 6478112245. If any stage fails, auto-rollback policy is ON.

nina: running quick smoke on staging-1 now :eyes:

nina: smoke ✅. Latency and output checks look normal. No regressions in quick suite.

sara: file a postmortem ticket for corrupted wheel (CI registry mirror). Add checksum verification in pipeline.

ben: created ticket #INFRA-391: 'Artifact mirror returned partial upload - add checksum and retry logic'. Adding release note: 'Pinned keras model to 0.3.0 to unblock release; rebuild of 0.3.1 in progress.'

mike: schedule: promote completes, start signed-release tomorrow morning during change window +2h. I'll monitor.

nina: thanks all. closing thread after final promote success.

ben: promote finished successfully at 6478112496.
